evidence.V1: Clasp bar + tapered ribbon + octagonal token read as a medal at 64 px in front, three-quarter and silhouette; outline symmetric (A15 X/Y error 0.0); top view is a thin bar as expected for a flat award.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big token and ribbon, medium chamfered gold rim and clasp bar, small cream diamond emblem and suspension ring.
evidence.V3: Chunky rim, strong ribbon taper and oversized clasp give a confident stylised medal; shapes stay simple but not stiff primitives.
evidence.V4: Token rim, clasp bar and diamond emblem have even chamfers that catch light, but the ribbon slab has razor-sharp corners and edges (clear in the ribbon close-up), so bevels are inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Token and ribbon faces shade clean, but the ring/ribbon/token junction reads as a lumpy, scalloped gold blob (ribbon close-up studio + flat), with the ring sunk 0.0825 studs into the token so it no longer reads as a loop.
evidence.V6: Gold accent, one hue (teal/crimson/royal/purple) in two values for ribbon and field, warm cream emblem; disciplined across colourways.
evidence.V7: 576 tris vs small-class target 600 (ceiling 1500): at target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material and kit palette match, but the un-chamfered ribbon breaks the kit's ~0.045-stud chamfer rule.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: CanCollide/CanQuery off, Massless when worn, Box collision, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin at clasp hang point.

artifacts: Ring/ribbon/token junction: ring sunk deep into the token top (penetration 0.0825) and the ribbon end overlapping it leaves a lumpy, scalloped gold shape instead of a readable ring loop
Ribbon slab edges and corners are unbevelled (razor) unlike the rest of the kit
top_fixes: Add the kit ~0.045-stud chamfer to the ribbon slab edges so it matches the rim and clasp
Raise the suspension ring so most of the loop sits above the token and have the ribbon end pass cleanly through it, giving a readable ring instead of a buried lump
Optional: add a cream centre stripe or a slight fold to the ribbon to add a small-detail tier on the top half
